highlights: Supports both CSV and JSON datasets
Computes grouped summaries and numeric stats
Flags anomalies using simple threshold rules
name: Remote Dataset Daily Report
description: Download a remote CSV or JSON dataset, compute daily aggregates, detect anomalies, and post a summary report.

files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements.txt
python main.py
